agent_explanation: Two ~17-18 mass bodies with G~4.73 fall toward each other to separation ~0.35-0.39 (steps 22-23), comparable to softening 0.3. Potential deepens to ~-3000 and kinetic rises to ~2500, but substeps only increase to 13-16 per outer step. Fixed-dt leapfrog with this substepping under-resolves the sharp pericenter, producing systematic energy error that accumulates to 137 (allowed 117) by step 24. Halving dt removes the violation, confirming timestep resolution as cause.
